## Architecture Overview

Grafana's HTTP client metrics middleware uses `prometheus.Registerer` directly in several middleware implementations. The primary files are `prometheus_metrics_middleware.go` for HTTP client metrics and `metrics_middleware.go` for plugin backend request metrics. Changing to a `MetricsCollector` interface breaks all components that register metrics through these middlewares.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Middleware Files

- **`prometheus_metrics_middleware.go`** — Defines `PrometheusMetrics` struct with `Register(registry prometheus.Registerer)`, `MustRegister(registry prometheus.Registerer)`, and `WithMustRegister(registry prometheus.Registerer)` methods. Creates and registers HTTP client metrics (counter, histogram, gauge).
- **`prometheus_metrics_middleware_test.go`** — Tests the PrometheusMetrics middleware.
- **`datasource_metrics_middleware.go`** — Datasource HTTP client metrics middleware using `promauto.NewCounterVec()`, `promauto.NewHistogramVec()` for automatic registration.
- **`datasource_metrics_middleware_test.go`** — Tests datasource metrics middleware.
- **`metrics_middleware.go`** (plugins) — Plugin request metrics middleware with `newMetricsMiddleware(promRegisterer prometheus.Registerer)` function. Registers metrics with `promRegisterer.MustRegister()` at line 69.
- **`metrics_middleware_test.go`** (plugins) — Tests plugin metrics middleware.

### Dependency Injection / Wiring

- **`pluginsintegration.go`** — Line 192: `clientmiddleware.NewMetricsMiddleware(promRegisterer, registry)`. Functions `ProvideClientWithMiddlewares()`, `NewMiddlewareHandler()`, `CreateMiddlewares()` all receive `promRegisterer prometheus.Registerer` as parameter.
- **`http_client_provider.go`** — HTTP client provider configuring datasource metrics middleware. Includes `DataSourceMetricsMiddleware()`.
- **`http_client_provider_test.go`** — Tests HTTP client provider.

| grafana | pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/datasource_metrics_middleware.go | Datasource metrics middleware using promauto registration |
| grafana | pkg/infra/httpclient/httpclientprovider/datasource_metrics_middleware_test.go | Tests for datasource metrics middleware |
| grafana | pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/metrics_middleware.go | Plugin metrics middleware using prometheus.Registerer |
